title: Tunisian Fish Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic North African stew originating from Tunisia, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This dish is a staple of Tunisian cuisine.

ingredients.name: Tunisian fish (such as bream or tilapia)

instructions: Heat oil in a large clay or ceramic tagine or Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic, ginger, cumin, and cayenne pepper. Cook for 1 minute.
Add fish, olives, lemon juice, salt, and pepper. Cook for 5 minutes.
Cover the tagine or Dutch oven and transfer to the oven.
Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 12-15 minutes or until the fish is cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with lemon wedges and fresh parsley, if desired.
